systems.system: Système intégré de gestion du permis de construire (SIGPC)
systems.tiers: Building permits issued by the mairie or the prefecture with the Direction générale de l'urbanisme et de l'habitat; running since 2017, and since 2022 mayors and local elected officials can consult the files of their commune and exchange with the instructing services
National; architect certification and building-permit requests integrated on 29 September 2026, files passed on to SIGPC

note: Says mayors and local elected officials have been able to consult their commune's permit files in SIGPC since 2022, but states no connection at a commune office and does not say where or over what they do so; SIGPC is an application, so no fact.
